title: Symbol Index Entry
description: One line of rig's symbol index (JSONL, one entry per definition). Generated deterministically by rig from the source at a given revision; never hand-written. Indexes definitions only: exported code symbols, IaC module inputs and outputs, contracts, and string contracts (metric, span, env var, PR label names). The index is the reuse map: the Builder retrieves from it, rig's rules check against it, and the Reviewer's reuse lens gets candidates from it. See 00_UniversalStandards/09_Reuse_and_DRY.md.

signature.description: Normalized signature, e.g. "(value: unknown) => unknown". Absent for string contracts.

sha.description: Commit the index was generated from.

purpose.description: First line of the doc comment, if any. Used for 'same thing, different name' retrieval.

visibility.description: shared = in packages/, schemas/, or marked @shared (and exported). Everything else, including undeclared or ambiguous, is internal (fail closed).

boundary.description: The declared boundary (TS package, Go module, Python package, Terraform module) the symbol belongs to.

body_hash.description: Hash of the normalized body (comments and whitespace removed, locals renamed to placeholders), prefixed with the normalizer version, e.g. "ts-norm-v1:9f2c...". Equal hashes = clone, whatever the name.

body_shingles.description: Near-miss signature (MinHash or winnowing) over the normalized token stream.

shape_fingerprint.description: For data shapes and contracts: canonical field-set fingerprint, comparable across languages.

value.description: For string contracts (metric, span, env var, label names): the exact string value.

cognitive_complexity.description: Per function, computed with Sonar's published rules. Absent for HCL and non-code kinds.
